verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a scheduling product, since some scheduling tools ship self-hostable editions, so the axis applies. Every piece of evidence describes Calendly as a hosted SaaS reached through its cloud API, embeds, webhooks and hosted MCP server, and none documents a self-hosted deployment. The one community mention of self-hosting is about a competitor, not Calendly, so it earns no credit.
